about: Mechatronics Engineering is an interdisciplinary field that combines mechanical, electrical, electronics, and computer engineering to design and develop intelligent systems and automation solutions. It focuses on creating smart machines, robotics, and advanced control systems that enhance efficiency and precision in various industries. Mechatronics engineers work on automation, robotics, embedded systems, sensors, and artificial intelligence to develop cutting-edge technologies used in manufacturing, healthcare, automotive, and aerospace sectors. With the increasing integration of IoT and AI-driven automation, Mechatronics Engineering plays a crucial role in modern industry, driving innovation in smart systems, autonomous machines, and intelligent manufacturing processes.
vision: To be a centre of excellence for development and dissemination of knowledge in Mechatronics Engineering for the Nation and beyond.
mission: Disseminate knowledge through effective teaching-learning process to develop technically competent and ethically strong Mechatronics professionals.
Foster continuous interdisciplinary learning and research to meet real-world challenges by nurturing innovation through state-of-the-art facilities.
Promote societal based consultancy and training services in collaboration with Industries and R&D organizations.
objective: To equip students with the necessary technical and managerial skills.
peo: Utilize the fundamental knowledge of basic sciences and engineering to succeed in their profession.
Design and develop Mechatronics products and processes for real world applications.
Exhibit professional and managerial capabilities with ethical conduct and have an aptitude for continuous learning.
po: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.

Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.

Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.
Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.

Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.

Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.
Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.

Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.

Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.
pso: Design and develop Mechatronic systems by synergistic combination of mechanical engineering, electronic controls and systems.
Adapt multidisciplinary approach to solve real world industrial problems.

detail: The Centre of Excellence in Robotics and Automation (CoE-R&A) is a cutting-edge state of art platform to learn, build, explore and realize Robot technologies. CoE-R&A established in 2021 and it holds modern equipment namely FANUC ER-4iA Robot, FANUC CNC Simulator, 6 Axis Industrial Manipulator ABB IRB 1410, Humanoid Robot: NAO 6th Gen, Dobot Magician Kit with Accessories, e-Yantra lab setup, Aristo Robot (MTAB), Lab VIEW Robotics sbRIO Starter Kit, NI 1742 Smart Camera Evaluation Kit, QBot 2e and various software tools with upgraded license to equip the users. It enables the user to experience the Robotic and Automation world to meet the growing demands for trained engineers in the industrial automation.

It also offers benefits for promoting research, participation in national and international competitions, availing grants. All the exercises mentioned in the syllabus of under graduate and postgraduate programs can be carried out in this centre. The dimension of the centre is 24 m x9 m, having total area of 216 m2. The total cost of the equipment is around Rs.1 Crore.

General maintenance like hardware troubleshooting, software reinstallation etc., are normally done by the centre technician and the system administrator of the college. In addition to the laboratory manual prepared by the department, the students have the facility to refer the company manuals. Two teaching faculties are conducting laboratory classes with the help of technical assistant. The faculty in-charges have a cabin inside the laboratory itself.
The centre has the facility to get 24 X 7 uninterrupted power supply with the help of UPS (30 kVA) with generator and also have a Compressor with 6 bar pressure is available.

Apart from the regular classes, Short-term courses, certification courses are arranged for the benefit of our students in the recent emerging fields during evening hours (4.30 to 7.30 pm) and also during holidays. The centre is kept open till 7 PM during working days. The software and hardware available in the centre are fully utilized by both UG and PG students to do their project work.
- Lab VIEW Robotics SbRIO Starter Kit
- Upgrade, NI Academic site License, Department Fall 2010
Computer Aided Manufacturing (CAM) centre affords space for students to work on diverse aspects of design and manufacturing related activities.
Students have access to advanced tools in Design, Analysis, Simulation and Manufacturing platforms to explore and gain knowledge.
This centre also focuses on providing hands-on experience in the additive manufacturing technique (Fused Deposition Modelling) to realize product development.

labs.topic: ROBERT E NEWNHAM SENSORS AND INTERNET OF THINGS LABORATORY
detail: The Sensors and Internet of Things (IoT) Laboratory is established to provide hands-on exposure to various industrial sensors, signal conditioning techniques, data acquisition systems, and modern IoT-based monitoring and control applications. The laboratory enables students to understand the principles of sensing, measurement, interfacing, and real-time data communication using embedded platforms and cloud services.This laboratory supports undergraduate and postgraduate courses by bridging the gap between theoretical concepts and real-world applications in sensor technology, instrumentation, embedded systems, and IoT-based automation. Students gain practical experience in calibration, signal processing, wireless communication, and cloud-based data analytics.

The laboratory is equipped with advanced sensor trainer kits, IoT-enabled measurement systems, embedded computers, and industry-standard software tools. It facilitates experimentation, mini-projects, credit courses, and research-oriented activities related to smart sensing and connected systems.
- DC & AC Bridges Kit with I/O Module
- Pressure Measurement Kit with IoT Module
- Angular Displacement Measurement Kit with IoT Module
- Load Cell Measurement Kit with IoT Module
- Level and Flow Rate Measurement Kit with IoT Module
- SCXI-1000 National Instruments Signal Conditioning Unit
- MATLAB with IoT and Data Analysis Toolboxes
- ThingSpeak (MATLAB-based Cloud Platform for IoT Data Visualization)
- HP Intel Core i7 PCs – 5 Nos
The laboratory also supports credit-based and value-added courses in emerging technologies, including:
- IoT Application Development and Device Control using Raspberry Pi and NodeMCU
- LoRa-Based Data Communication, Application Management, and Remote Device Control
- Cloud-Based Sensor Data Monitoring using MATLAB ThingSpeak Platform
These courses enable students to design end-to-end IoT solutions involving sensor data acquisition, wireless transmission, cloud storage, visualization, and remote control of devices.
- Understanding characteristics and applications of various sensors
- Hands-on experience with signal conditioning and instrumentation
- Real-time data acquisition and wireless data transmission
- Development of IoT-enabled monitoring and control systems
- Exposure to cloud-based data analytics and visualization
- Support for mini-projects, final-year projects, and research activities

The Control Engineering Laboratory facilitates students in enhancing their learning of control systems in time and frequency domain. It imparts knowledge on developing mathematical models of physical systems and analyzing their behavior.

labs.topic: Electron Devices and Digital Circuits Laboratory
detail: Electron devices and digital circuits laboratory is intended for teaching and project development in electric circuits, electronic devices and digital Electronics. It aims at inculcating knowledge on basic concepts and operation of electronic devices and digital circuits. This lab covers the basic devices that serve as the most basic building block of almost all electronic and electrical devices. The lab supports the students to build their circuits on breadboard using electronic components, ICs, power supplies and other electronic equipments. It also provides logic level realization of different digital circuit such as logic gates, flip-flops, counters, registers, multiplexers, de-multiplexers etc. This laboratory enables students to learn prototyping, soldering, wiring and testing their own circuits. Besides regular class-work, skills of the students are honed by their participation in real time circuit buliding assignments. PCB prototype making machine provide holistic experience for students in enhancing their knowledge in the design and fabrication of Single-layer and double-layer printed circuit board. This infrastructure is used to conduct skill development training programs for students which helps the students to become an industry ready engineer.
- Soldering Rework Station With Air Gun
The Project Laboratory is a place for creative learning and innovation. Here, students get valuable hands-on experience with a state-of-the-art environment in the field of Mechatronics Engineering.
- EIFCO Make 20mm Gear type bench drilling Machine

This Laboratory focuses on educating the students on in depth knowledge on basic foundation on robotics for all the first-year students. This lab focuses on designing the Electronics Circuit and its Debugging, interfacing of sensors, actuators and wireless communication modules with Arduino microcontroller, Assembly of tracker Robot with accessories, Development of embedded programming and interfacing for motion control and obstacle avoidance, Demonstration and testing of Robot in static environment.
